quests.name: === MAIN QUESTS
quests.unknownHint: The old man at the Raevula Waterfront has a crazy idea for a heroic quest.
quests.overview: A new quest for brave adventurers to undertake the journey of a lifetime.

quests.name: The Journey Begins With Darkness...
quests.overview:
On an island residing on some distant lesser-known planet exists a land its people call 'Erocia'. The land is largely overrun by monsters with the exception of a few sparse settlements. Deep in the depths of the Lair of Erocian Death, resides a particular slime monster whose goopy exomorpha is uniquely known to breakdown into a supposedly ambrosia-like pudding.

This quest begins there, with our protagonists(?) having come far searching for this delectable treat.

objectives.description: The supposed slime is somewhere in the depths of the Lair of Erocian Death, travel deeper to find it!

logs.active: Go learn about attacking so you don't die in this death cave.
logs.completed: Attacking is important, you'll use it lots.

indiscriminate.hint: Head in deeper into the cave, and practice attacking.

objectives.description: Tutorials aren't very exciting, but it seems this cave is full of them.

logs.active: Go learn about executing skills so you can kill shit faster.
logs.completed: Skills are useful, spam them where necessary to save thineself.

indiscriminate.hint: Head in even deeper into the cave, and practice skills.

objectives.description: More tutorials? Well, get learning, bitch.

logs.active: Go learn about guarding so you can defend yourself.
logs.completed: If you're lazy you'll probably never use this, but its pretty cool once you get the hang of it.

indiscriminate.hint: Head deeper yet into the cave, and practice guarding.

objectives.description: \N[1] is good at melee stuff, time to get some hands-on combat practice!

logs.active: Chopping up ghostys never felt so exciting!
logs.completed: After chopping up the ghostys, you feel proud.

indiscriminate.hint: Head in deeper into the cave, and show off what you've learned.

objectives.description: Tutorials are pretty boring but they are a necessary evil.

logs.active: You'll need to progress further before more objectives unlock themselves.
logs.completed: Who knew there'd be more combat practice?

indiscriminate.hint: Spelunk further into the cave.

objectives.description: \N[2] is good at ranged stuff, time to get some more hands-on combat practice!

logs.active: Blasting ghostys never felt so exciting!
logs.completed: After blasting the ghostys, you feel proud.

indiscriminate.hint: Head in deeper into the cave, and show off what you've learned.

objectives.description: Where is the slime? It has to be deeper yet...

logs.active: Descend deeper and find the slime you seek.
logs.completed: The slime was located!

indiscriminate.hint: Head in deeper into the cave, and hopefully encounter no more tutorials omg.

objectives.description: It is pretty unlikely the \Enemy[251] will willingly give you its flesh, so that means you get to take it by force.

logs.active: Chop up the \Enemy[14] and carve off a chunk of its exomorpha!
logs.completed: The \Armor[401] was acquired, fucking finally.

quests.name: Trekking to Town
quests.overview: If cooking is the goal, then our protagonists will need a kitchen. Chances are, a town would probably have a kitchen available, which makes the next leg of this journey a trip to the nearest town.

objectives.description: If you hope to cook, you'll need a kitchen- and there isn't one in the cave. Get outta here!

logs.active: Unless you want to farm more slime, just get out of here.
logs.completed: Whoa its so bright outside!

indiscriminate.hint: Leave the Lair of Erocian Death.

objectives.description: Apparently \N[2] spotted a town to the \C[1]West\C[0]. Go forth!

logs.active: Looks like there was a town nearby called \C[1]Raevula\C[0], hopefully they have a kitchen.
logs.completed: The town ain't half bad. With a few fixes, this could become a nice Quest Hub...

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the path to the \C[2]West\C[0] and reach \C[1]Raevula\C[0].

objectives.description: Any respectable town has an inn, and where there is an inn, there is probably a kitchen. Check it out!

logs.active: Go check-in with the inn and speak with the innkeeper.
logs.completed: Of course its never as simple as 'go to the inn and cook the shit'...

indiscriminate.hint: Enter the inn.

quests.name: Bearcats For Pudding?
quests.overview: The mandate by the busty innkeeper is that if you want to use her inn's kitchen, you first have to go do some cleanup of the bearcat population. Specifically the bearcats that like to hang out outside the town gates since they are apparently terrorizing the citizens- or something like that.

objectives.description: Before you're allowed to use the kitchen, you have to go chop up \enemy[351]s.

logs.active: Go chop up the bearcats to gain access to the kitchen.
logs.completed: Maybe if you're lucky you might've gotten some of their flank, too!

objectives.description: Go back and boast about your amazing efforts chopping up \enemy[351]s.

logs.active: The innkeeper will surely be pleased you chopped up four of them.
logs.completed: The innkeeper was pleased you chopped them up so swiftly, albeit a bit surprised you survived.

indiscriminate.hint: Report back to the innkeeper about your genocide.

objectives.description: Go make the \item[151].

logs.active: The kitchen is available to you! The pudding is finally within your grasp!
logs.completed: Well... that wasn't what one would expect from "pudding"...

quests.name: The Mayor of Raevula
quests.overview: \N[2] detects something ominous about the citizenry of \C[1]Raevula\C[0] and suggests some investigation is in order. \N[1] agrees and suggests they just skip the shit and go directly to the important blue house- it is probably a mayor's house and the mayor probably knows what is up with their own people...

objectives.description: Check out the blue-roofed house- which probably belongs to the mayor in \C[1]the Northwestern section of Raevula\C[0].

logs.active: Hopefully the blue-roofed house in the NW of Raevula has some answers.
logs.completed: Wow this place is huger than it looks from the outside.

indiscriminate.hint: Go check out the blue-roofed house in NW Raevula.

objectives.description: Gotta get a weapon somehow, might as well start at a smith.

logs.active: The southeastern section had a smith, didn't it?
logs.completed: Huh, a drunkard old man smith. Who would've guessed.

indiscriminate.hint: Go to \C[1]The Metal Petal\C[0] smithery.

objectives.description: This really is a tutorial lap around Raevula- first the smith and now the pub...

logs.active: The pub was just across from the inn- easy to find.
logs.completed: Old men are so easy to persuade!

indiscriminate.hint: Find the smith in \C[1]The Red Baron\C[0] pub.

objectives.description: That smith is a hoot! Viskra is sure to appreciate your assistance.

logs.active: Viskra has to thank you for going out of your way to help a total stranger!
logs.completed: She was indeed thankful, and now the smith will surely help you.

indiscriminate.hint: Report to Viskra your success.

objectives.description: Have the smith help you with making your first weapons.

logs.active: Looks like just bringing gramps home isn't enough- he wants to enlist your services for more mind-numbing tutorial shit.
logs.completed: Well, at least you got to stretch your legs and also got some levels and weapons out of it.

indiscriminate.hint: Report to Viskra your success.

objectives.description: Go have a chat with the mayor- he is waiting in the entry hall of his mansion.

logs.active: Damn this is one huge mansion... is that the mayor up there looking down on you from the second floor?
logs.completed: Okay well no one expected the mayor would be like \_that\_.

indiscriminate.hint: Have a chat with the mayor.

objectives.description: You don't want to wait to see what the mayor has in store for you, so figure out how to escape the wing.

logs.active: Seek out a means to escape the mansion wing you've been locked in.
logs.completed: Jumping down mysterious holes in the wall does \_technically\_ count as an escape...

indiscriminate.hint: Figure out how to escape the mansion wing.

objectives.description: It is unclear why there were mines directly beneath the mayor's mansion, but you should escape those, too.

logs.active: The mine tunnels and caverns are twisted and labyrinthine, but escaping is the only alternative to death.
logs.completed: Holy fucking cripes, mines suck as a first real dungeon.

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate out of the mines.

objectives.description: Going from one dungeon directly to another usually means there is something at the end... but what?

logs.active: This forest holds an aura of mystery and danger, what could be at the heart of it?
logs.completed: A... cabin?

indiscriminate.hint: Explore the depths of the forest.

objectives.description: What could a cabin be doing so deep in such a deadly forest? Only one way to find out...

logs.active: An adventurer never leaves such a juicy secret unrevealed- explore that damn cabin.
logs.completed: Definitely didn't expect to find the mayor out here!

indiscriminate.hint: Investigate the busted up cabin.

objectives.description: Who would've guessed the mayor was hanging out in the basement of a busted up cabin? Take care of business.

logs.active: The mayor isn't leaving you much of a choice- defeat him!
logs.completed: He called himself "the sin of gluttony"... what could that mean?

quests.name: A Way to the Kingdom!
quests.overview: After bouncing ideas back and forth, \N[1] and \N[2] decide its probably best to head out and check out this kingdom. There was no reason a party of adventurers would've wanted to come out to Raevula all on their own, so might as well go follow the clues to see if you can solve this conundrum.

objectives.description: The innkeeper probably knows the directions to the Erocian Kingdom, so why not ask her?

logs.active: There is only one way to find out if she knows- might as well ask.
logs.completed: What a convoluted fucking route...

indiscriminate.hint: Go chat with the innkeeper back in Raevula.

objectives.description: Apparently, the pink-haired kid knows about the alchemist??? Sure why not.

logs.active: The pink-haired kid probably listened to the boastful Alchemist, so get him to cough up some answers!
logs.completed: So the nature-lover has the answer? Back to \C[3]The Forest of Dreams\C[0] then.

indiscriminate.hint: Have a chat with the pink-haired kid.

objectives.description: So the Nature-Lover is acquainted with the Alchemist? The forest has the answer then.

logs.active: The 'hawt hippie' is definitely the Nature-Lover... and she is in the forest.
logs.completed: Seems like the cliffs were the way the Alchemist took. You're getting somewhere.

indiscriminate.hint: Ask the Nature-Lover about the Alchemist.

objectives.description: With the other fork blocked by a mysterious rock, you have no choice but to descend into the depths of \C[2]The Forlorn Basin\C[0].

logs.active: Its basically a dank ass wet cave, and the alchemist is somewhere down there. Probably.
logs.completed: Woops, guess ya better save him from his demise!

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate \C[2]The Forlorn Basin\C[0] and find the alchemist.

objectives.description: The alchemist was located, and just in the nick of time- he was about to get his face melted by a stupid slime!

logs.active: Holy shit, save him before he dies! You'll never get a tool if he gets melted by a \Enemy[253]!
logs.completed: Why does everything in this stupid cave regenerate so much???

objectives.description: With a new tool in-hand, the other path leading to \C[1]The Outer Cliffs\C[0] is available.

logs.active: One only need return to the entrance of the basin to find the blocked path to the cliffs.
logs.completed: Wow, where are those leaves falling from?

indiscriminate.hint: Use the tool to reach the cliffs.

objectives.description: Physics aside, \C[1]The Outer Cliffs\C[0] are a nice breath of fresh air- now time to get through em.

logs.active: They are pretty windy, but navigating them should be a breeze!
logs.completed: Did we take a wrong turn?

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate through the cliffs.

quests.name: The Path Continues East
quests.overview:
It is truly astonishing how geography works! After a roundabout route through some caves and along a cliff, our protagonists end up in a familiar sight- where their adventure first started!

Unfortunately for them, the path is much longer and will require many more twists and turns before they reach their destination, so the path continues.

objectives.description: It feels like only yesterday you were here, but you must go forth- onward and Eastward!

logs.active: The fork has four paths, but the sign says "go east for the kingdom", so you should do that.
logs.completed: Onward and Eastward you continue!

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the path East from the \C[1]Adventurer's Fork\C[0].

objectives.description: All signs point to going even further East.

logs.active: We all know signs never lie, so you should continue East.
logs.completed: Handling flooding sure seems like a lot of work for random adventurers...

objectives.description: In order to proceed through to the Erocian Kingdom, the flooding needs to be dealt with, so go slap that water entity.

logs.active: We'll have to resolve the flooding woes of Erocia before we can get to the kingdom.
logs.completed: Wow, the water levels HAVE receded!

objectives.description: Report back to \C[1]Treis\C[0] at the Inn in Raevula to inform her that its time to proceed.

logs.active: Time to go back to the Comfy Bear Inn.
logs.completed: Lets try again, but for real this time.

indiscriminate.hint: Go chat with \C[1]Treis\C[0] at the Inn in Raevula.

quests.name: The Adventure Doesn't Stop
quests.overview: The water levels being receded means the path forward is clear! Our protagonists journey forth to further explore the wilds of Erocia as they cross the great green isthmus of Erocia and beyond where deadly monsters reside and spelunkable caves are plentiful.

objectives.description: Now that the water levels have receded, time to head back to the isthmus and meet up with \C[1]Treis\C[0].

logs.active: Treis is hanging out where we first met her, so we should sync up with her there.
logs.completed: Wow she is gonna spelunk without us? Well good luck to her I guess.

indiscriminate.hint: Return to the isthmus entrance and meet \C[1]Treis\C[0].

objectives.description: The isthmus doesn't look very big, but you'll need to get across it to get to the kingdom.

logs.active: The isthmus is windy, wet, and full of monsters- but we still gotta get across.
logs.completed: At least the weather doesn't change much in these parts.

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate the isthmus.

objectives.description: The kingdom is to the North and so North you shall go.

logs.active: The kingdom is further to the North apparently.
logs.completed: \_Another\_ dungeon?

indiscriminate.hint: Keep going North to reach the kingdom.

objectives.description: It is unclear how deep or big this grotto is, but again you must navigate this dungeon to reach the kingdom.

logs.active: It is blazing hot in this grotto, lets get through it ASAP.

indiscriminate.hint: Proceed into the \C[2]Volcanis Grotto\C[0].

objectives.description: There are simply too many stakes to ignore- lets find that damn \item[126] and get through this blazing grotto!

logs.active: Delve deeper into the \C[2]Volcanis Grotto\C[0] to find yourself some \item[126].
logs.completed: \*YET ANOTHER BOSS?!\* At least we got \item[126] lol.

indiscriminate.hint: Find the \item[126] somewhere in the \C[2]Volcanis Grotto\C[0].

objectives.description: It seems you have no choice but to defeat yet another elemental entity- this time of \element[4].

logs.active: A malicious entity stands before you and escaping this infernal cavern- end them.
logs.completed: Oh sweet, another party member!

objectives.description: Allies and tools gained, time to use your \item[126] to get out of this molten cave; it fucking sucks in here.

logs.active: Enough time spent in this damn fiery cave- get outta here.
logs.completed: Not too much further North, right?

indiscriminate.hint: Backtrack out of the \C[2]Volcanis Grotto\C[0] and continue North.

objectives.description: Supposedly the kingdom is only a bit further to the North, keep going!

logs.active: How much further North do we need to go?
logs.completed: Oh... didn't see a fallen kingdom in our future.

indiscriminate.hint: Continue on the final stretch North to the kingdom.

quests.name: A Fallen Kingdom
quests.overview:
The Erocian Kingdom was \_supposed\_ to be the destination where you'd find that there was a guild that sent the four (now dead) adventurers to Raevula to help the mayor with something(?), but the kingdom is... definitely destroyed. What will become of your journey now?

It is a protagonist's responsibility to solve these kinds of conundrums, so...

objectives.description: The Erocian Kingdom is obviously rekt, so go dive in and see if you can figure out why.

logs.active: No use crying over spilt milk, time to explore and see what we can find.
logs.completed: So we need more advanced technology to continue...

indiscriminate.hint: Explore the ruins of the fallen kingdom.

objectives.description: Seems the gate won't open for anyone without the right "key".

logs.active: What kind of "key" would open a gate that advanced?
logs.completed: "Technodisk" does sound kinda cool...

indiscriminate.hint: Find the "key" that opens the gate.

objectives.description: The ruins are vast, and the castle is in sight in the distance.

logs.active: There has to be a way into the castle, right? \*Brute force\* or \_otherwise\_...
logs.completed: Wow, even the castle is dark...

indiscriminate.hint: Find a way into the fallen kingdom's castle.

objectives.description: Fallen kingdom or not, there is a fancy red carpet that probably leads to the throne room- go forth!

logs.active: What kind of king rules over a fallen kingdom like this?
logs.completed: Ahh, \*that\* kind.

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the royal red carpet to the throne room.

objectives.description: Another sin or whatever- probably the one responsible for this busted up castle.

logs.active: Kill that bitch before he kills you!
logs.completed: Killing bitches is satisfying.

objectives.description: The sin is defeated, but what of the kingdom?

logs.active: The kingdom is not your problem.
logs.completed: The kingdom is not your problem, time to find another minion.

indiscriminate.hint: Discuss what is next.

quests.name: Peak Performance
quests.overview: In an agreement with the other elementals, our fearless protagonists have decided to round up the final elemental in an effort to round out the elemental spread of the party. However, considering the fourth of the primary elementals is \element[6], it means you'll be ascending a mountain... and where did you last see mountains? Just north of Raevula. So go to Raevula and head due north to check out the \C[1]Negative Peaks\C[0].

objectives.description: Head north of Raevula to reach the foothills of the peaks.

logs.active: Apparently snakerope is necessary for ascending to the peaks, good thing we have that!
logs.completed: And there was also a gate in the way, what a peculiar place for that.

indiscriminate.hint: Use the snakerope to reach the foothills of the peaks.

objectives.description: Ascend the mountain to reach the summit!

logs.active: There is an SOS signal at the summit?
logs.completed: Yikes, apparently the only way forward is into those icy caves.

indiscriminate.hint: Begin your ascent to reach the summit.

objectives.description: Navigate the icy caves to continue the ascent.

logs.active: No one said it would be easy to reach the summit.
logs.completed: Sliding-on-ice puzzles are fun, aren't they?

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate the icy caves.

objectives.description: There is no choice but to continue the ascent to the summit.

logs.active: The snowstorm really makes it tough to see, but the ascent contnues!
logs.completed: The SOS signal is just ahead! To rest or not to rest?

indiscriminate.hint: Continue the ascent to the summit.

objectives.description: SOS just ahead! Which means the summit is, too.

logs.active: Head to the summit when ready.
logs.completed: Definitely not predictable to fight the fourth elemental...

indiscriminate.hint: Proceed to the summit when fully prepared.

objectives.description: Defeat \N[6]!

logs.active: Self-preservation is important! Dying means gameover!
logs.completed: Even when they are your eventual allies, defeating bitches is satisfying.

objectives.description: Discuss the situation with \N[6].

logs.active: It is important to be able to discuss things in great detail.
logs.completed: It always seems there are more unanswered questions after these long discussions...

indiscriminate.hint: Discuss what is next.

quests.name: === TRAINING QUESTS
quests.unknownHint: The old man at the Raevula Waterfront has a crazy idea for a heroic quest.
quests.overview: A new quest for brave adventurers to undertake the journey of a lifetime.

quests.name: The Lord of Training - Part 1
quests.unknownHint: Is that a transdimensional portal I see over there?
quests.overview: Beyond a transdimensional rift, a very strange and almost-omniscient fellow gives you a call-to-action, offering you some friendly advice on how to survive in various combat situations beyond what was encountered in the \C[1]Lair of Erocian Death\C[0] in exchange for loot.

objectives.description: Why in the world are there transdimensional portals on such an obviously-not-that-advanced planet???

logs.active: Transdimensional portals are out of place in this land, you should probably investigate.
logs.completed: What the actual fuck?
logs.missed: It was just a transdimensional portal, who cares why it was here?

indiscriminate.hint: Enter the transdimensional portal in \C[1]Raevula\C[0].

objectives.description: It seems you have no choice- if you want the loot, you must undertake this Lord's challenge.

logs.active: Seems accepting the offer is the only way to advance, but is it worth it?
logs.completed: What is the worst that can happen? Death?
logs.missed: Walking away and ignoring side quests is always an option.

indiscriminate.hint: Accept \C[1]Trainer Lord\C[0]'s offer to learn more.

objectives.description: Looks like you have to complete Trainer Lord's series of tests in and reach the bottom to acquire the loot.

logs.active: There are a multitude of tests and combat scenarios to complete to get the loot, hopefully its worth it.
logs.completed: Loot is always worth the risk.
logs.missed: Tests are hard, death is scary- no loot is worth having to try.

indiscriminate.hint: Complete the tests and reach the bottom of the training zone.

quests.name: The Lord of Teleportals
quests.unknownHint: What a strange techno-gadget in the basin's deepest depths...
quests.overview: Beyond a transdimensional rift, a very strange and almost-omniscient fellow offers you yet more boons in exchange for... nothing?

objectives.description: What is such a strange an advanced technological gadget doing in the depths of the basin?

logs.active: It is hard to miss such a strange gadget in the depths of the \C[2]Forlorn Basin\C[0]...
logs.completed: Back here again?

indiscriminate.hint: Use the gadget in the basin.

objectives.description: The annoying voice of the Trainer Lord echoes in your head... guess you better answer the call.

logs.active: This guy truly is a fucking creeper.
logs.completed: Well, those boons are useful to the say the least!

indiscriminate.hint: Follow Trainer Lord's instructions and go chat with him.

quests.name: === SIDE QUESTS
quests.unknownHint: The old man at the Raevula Waterfront has a crazy idea for a heroic quest.
quests.overview: A new quest for brave adventurers to undertake the journey of a lifetime.

quests.name: First-time Forgery
quests.overview: The smithery of Raevula is impressive to behold, yet the primary smith is a fucking drunkard- not the most conducive to you getting your smithery things done. Looks like you get to help them out of a hard spot if you want them to help you at all.

objectives.description: Looks like Viktor and Viskra run the shop, and they are low on raw materials. You get the materials, they teach you how to smith.

logs.active: You'll need to fetch a pile of about 10 ore in order to help resupply the smith.
logs.completed: Mind-numbing fetching of ore complete!

indiscriminate.hint: Go talk to the smith at the pub.

objectives.description: Such simple gestures all so you can unlock new systems like crafting weapons.

logs.active: Return to \C[1]The Metal Petal\C[0] and deliver the ore.
logs.completed: The simple things you do to build relationships with permanent NPCs...

indiscriminate.hint: Report to Viskra your success.

objectives.description: Smithing doesn't seem too hard, just make a \weapon[2] and \weapon[122], and show them off to Viskra, right?

logs.active: Gotta 'upgrade' our weapons- better hit the apprentice forge, then show Viskra the fruits of your labor.
logs.completed: Easy as pie.

indiscriminate.hint: Smith up the \weapon[2] and \weapon[122], then show them to Viskra.

quests.name: A Self-Exiled Nature-Lover?
quests.unknownHint: Does anyone know what the deal is with that empty lot in Raevula?
quests.overview:
According to the random citizen of Raevula, the empty lot was once a house that the nature-lover lived in... but she left to \C[2]The Forest of Dreams\C[0], claiming something about how the Mayor was 'violating nature' or something. 
What was their deal?

objectives.description: Perhaps if you encounter the Nature-Lover in \C[2]The Forest of Dreams\C[0], you could ask more about what happened?

logs.active: Who knows why Nature-Lovers do what they do? Everyone has morals they follow...
logs.completed: Damn that mayor is one fucking douchebag- but hey, more recipeeeeeees!

indiscriminate.hint: Have a talk with the Nature-Lover to understand more.

quests.name: Four Former Protagonists
quests.overview: Seems the would-be adventurers that visited the Mayor suffered a similar fate and were locked up in the same wing as you were- however, their escape was... less than successful. No sense in leaving their goods to go to waste, might as well see what all four of em had before you exit the mines.

objectives.description: If you want the free loot, you'll need to take some extra effort to find their bodies first- all four of em.

logs.active: Four bodies mean four sets of loot- totally worth it, right?
logs.completed: Better you have this stuff than them- ya know, since they are dead.
logs.missed: No amount of loot is worth navigating those fucking mines, forget it.

indiscriminate.hint: Loot the four dead protagonists before exiting the mines.

quests.name: A Sword In Some Stone
quests.unknownHint: Somewhere, there is a sword in a stone...
quests.overview:
It seems there is a sword embedded in a stone- very much like Arthurian legend describes. Obviously this isn't Excalibur, but it is probably a pretty badass sword... if you can yank it out.

You probably \C[2]need a good amount of strength\C[0] to free it from its stony encasement.

objectives.description: Get \N[1] buff enough to rip the sword out of the stone it is embedded in!

logs.active: Can you even rip, bro?
logs.completed: 255+ power is nothing to you!

indiscriminate.hint: Gain enough strength to free the sword from its stone.

quests.name: The Path of the Magic Fox
quests.overview: It isn't clear exactly how this creature arrived on this planet, nor why it seems to be trying to get you to follow it... but you should follow it. Maybe it leads to loot?

objectives.description: Follow the Magic Fox into the Lair of Erocian Death once again and see what the heck is going on.

logs.active: The Magic Fox appears to have bolted into the Lair of Erocian Death, follow it!
logs.completed: It ran off again.

indiscriminate.hint: Follow that Magic Fox!

objectives.description: Follow the Magic Fox deeper into the Lair of Erocian Death.

logs.active: The Magic Fox ran away again- keep following it!
logs.completed: It ran off yet again.

indiscriminate.hint: Keep following that Magic Fox!

objectives.description: Follow the Magic Fox into the hole it just created.

logs.active: The Magic Fox obliterated the wall in the cave and exposed a hole- follow it!
logs.completed: It lead us into... a dungeon within a dungeon?

indiscriminate.hint: Follow that Magic Fox into its hole!

quests.name: Into the Earthen Layer
quests.overview: The hole the Magic Fox revealed is deep and twisted with deadly foes all about. It isn't clear what could be at the bottom of these depths, but what good adventurer would pass up an opportunity to explore?

objectives.description: The Earthen Layer is several floors deep and you get to explore it!

logs.active: The Earthen Layer sure is deep- what could be at the bottom?
logs.completed: Puzzles. Of course puzzles are at the bottom.

indiscriminate.hint: Descend into the depths of the Earthen Layer.

objectives.description: The ancient gate appears to be sealed by some power- probably classic boulder-moving puzzles.

logs.active: Solving puzzles is fun sometimes... pushing boulders, less so.
logs.completed: Never going to push another boulder again.

indiscriminate.hint: Solve the boulder-moving puzzles to unseal the gate.

objectives.description: There was a distinct "computer-ey noise" that probably indicated the ancient gate is open!

logs.active: Pest control first- the \Enemy[301]s are eating the margins.
logs.completed: The plots are Wolftrap-free.

indiscriminate.hint: Clear the Wolftraps infesting Peter's plots.

objectives.description: A couple of nastier ones burrowed in too, for the thorough.

logs.active: A couple of \Enemy[302]s burrowed in too, if you're feeling thorough.
logs.completed: Extra-thorough pest control, complete.

indiscriminate.hint: Clear out the lurking Bloodtraps while you're at it.

objectives.description: Two experts, one field, zero words exchanged. They simply dig.

logs.active: Dig. The potato expert is already three rows ahead of you.
logs.completed: Twenty potatoes of championship quality. Jerald and Peter never exchanged a word. They didn't need to.

indiscriminate.hint: Work the plots and harvest 20 potatoes.

objectives.description: Same market. Same day. Best harvest of his life.

logs.active: Same market. Same day. Best harvest of his life.
logs.completed: The town chose the better crop. Money can't buy what soil remembers.

indiscriminate.hint: See the harvest to market alongside Peter.

quests.name: The Collapse
quests.unknownHint: Vanderslop's spot outside the inn is conspicuously empty.
quests.overview: And then the money stops. The fortune was always Wyatt's, and Wyatt is dead- the estate was never actually Vanderslop's to spend. The vanity farm collapses overnight, the tributes are unaffordable, and the man himself is suddenly, conspicuously gone. What IS a Saiko-heir with no inheritance? For now: nobody knows.

objectives.description: No ranting. No raving. Something is wrong.

logs.active: No ranting. No raving. The silence outside the inn is deafening.
logs.completed: He's not there. He's ALWAYS there.

indiscriminate.hint: Notice the empty spot outside the Comfy Bear Inn.

objectives.description: The town that spent years dodging his rants has no idea where he went.

logs.active: Nobody has seen him. Nobody knows. Nobody expected to care.
logs.completed: He's just... gone. Huh.

indiscriminate.hint: Ask around town about where Vanderslop went.

quests.name: His Keeper
quests.overview: It is Peter- of course it is Peter- who asks you to go check on him. The man Vanderslop spent years humiliating is the only person in Raevula who noticed he stopped eating. 'He demanded three salads a week. A man doesn't just stop demanding salads.'

objectives.description: The tormented worries for the tormentor. Naturally.

logs.active: 'A man doesn't just stop demanding salads.' Peter, you absolute saint.
logs.completed: Someone should check on him. That someone is you.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Peter's concern for his tormentor.

objectives.description: The first food in this entire saga that is given, not demanded.

logs.active: The first food in this whole saga that's given, not demanded.
logs.completed: One hot meal, made with something dangerously close to sympathy.

indiscriminate.hint: Prepare a hot meal to bring along- any cooked dish will do.

objectives.description: Rock bottom has a location, and someone is at it.

logs.active: Rock bottom has a location. Go to it.
logs.completed: Unwashed, unwealthy, and- for the first time in the entire chain- honest.

indiscriminate.hint: Find Vanderslop at his rock bottom.

quests.name: The Fork
quests.overview: The conclusion. Stripped of everything, what Vanderslop becomes next is decided here- and Peter, naturally, extends the only offer that matters: honest work, and the shirt off his own back. Literally. THE tunic.

objectives.description: The chain's tribute economy ends with a gift.

logs.active: The tribute economy ends with Peter giving away the shirt off his back.
logs.completed: The tunic has a new farmer. Maybe.

indiscriminate.hint: Deliver Peter's restored Verte Tunic to Vanderslop.

objectives.description: Redemption or ruin- his call, with nothing left to spend on the answer.

logs.active: Redemption or ruin- his call, at last.
logs.completed: The triangle resolves. Peter has no idea he won anything. He never thought he was competing.

indiscriminate.hint: See how Vanderslop answers the offer.

quests.name: The Deed
quests.unknownHint: The vanity farm is going on the market.
quests.overview: The vanity farm survived its owner's bankruptcy, and now it's on the market. And who on this continent is drowning in gold? You are. Buy the farm, hire your farmer, and see what happens when you're handed Vanderslop's exact position: landowner, employer, rich beyond need.

objectives.description: An entire farm operation, gently used, one previous owner (bankrupt).

logs.active: An entire farm operation, gently used, one previous owner (bankrupt).
logs.completed: The paperwork is real. The price is... substantial.

indiscriminate.hint: Attend the probate sale of the vanity farm.

objectives.description: Twenty hours of monster wallets finally have somewhere to go.

logs.active: Twenty hours of monster wallets finally have somewhere to go.
logs.completed: You own a farm now. A FARM.

indiscriminate.hint: Pay the 1,000,000G and take the deed.

objectives.description: A farm needs hands, and two candidates exist. One is having a very humbling year.

logs.active: Two candidates, technically. One of them is having a very humbling year.
logs.completed: The farm has hands. Return daily for the fruits- and roots- of their labor.

indiscriminate.hint: Hire your farmer- Peter, and perhaps another.

quests.name: Are You Aliens?
quests.unknownHint: A curious man loiters outside the Save Shrine, staring at YOU.
quests.overview: You used the Save Shrine like it was Tuesday. Cerak the Archaeologist spent HOURS trying to coax anything out of that sigil, and along come two strangers who just... touch it and go. He needs proof it wasn't a fluke: three more sigils surround Raevula. Parse them.

objectives.description: The man watched you save your game and now has QUESTIONS.

logs.active: The man watched you leave the shrine and now has QUESTIONS.
logs.completed: 'Prove it. Three sigils surround the town. Parse them.' Deal.

indiscriminate.hint: Get intercepted by Cerak outside the Save Shrine.

objectives.description: One of three mysterious sigils surrounding Raevula.

logs.active: The first of three sigils awaits a reader.
logs.completed: The first sigil hums for you. Cerak is losing his mind.

indiscriminate.hint: Parse the first sigil surrounding Raevula.

objectives.description: The second of the three sigils.

logs.active: Two down after this one...
logs.completed: Second sigil parsed like a light novel.

indiscriminate.hint: Parse the second sigil surrounding Raevula.

objectives.description: The last of the three sigils.

logs.active: Just the one left...
logs.completed: Three for three. Definitely not a fluke.

indiscriminate.hint: Parse the third sigil surrounding Raevula.

objectives.description: The archaeologist's worldview is about to need renovations.

logs.active: Time to shatter a man's worldview, gently.
logs.completed: 'Are you aliens?' He's almost right. He'll never know how almost.

indiscriminate.hint: Report your findings to Cerak.

quests.name: The Dig
quests.unknownHint: Cerak has relocated to a dig camp in the Crystalline Ravine.
quests.overview: Sigil-parsing proved you CAN read the things; now Cerak needs older stones. His research points to the Crystalline Ravine- the oldest surviving structure anyone knows of, older than it has any right to be. Escort the dig, and read what's buried down there.

objectives.description: The old man packed up his whole life and moved it into a ravine.

logs.active: The old man moved his whole life into a ravine. Respect.
logs.completed: The camp is small, organized, and vibrating with academic excitement.

indiscriminate.hint: Meet Cerak at his dig camp in the Crystalline Ravine.

objectives.description: Archaeology is mostly hauling. Nobody tells you that part.

logs.active: Archaeology is mostly hauling. Nobody tells you that part.
logs.completed: The dig hits something that shouldn't be there.

indiscriminate.hint: Assist the dig deep in the ravine.

objectives.description: Sigil-script, deep beneath everything, matching the Save Shrine's.

logs.active: The script matches the Save Shrine's. Down here. Under everything.
logs.completed: The town's mystery has ancestors, and they're everywhere underneath everything.

indiscriminate.hint: Parse the sigil-script uncovered in the depths.

quests.name: The Four Great Stones
quests.unknownHint: The ravine script points north- to the Desolate Graves.
quests.overview: Four great monuments stand in the Desolate Graves that no living person built, beside a wreckage that isn't there. Cerak has cross-referenced every record the continent has- all seven years of them- and the stones predate everything. He's hiring the only two people who can read anything to go touch all four.

objectives.description: 'Go touch all four. That's the whole job.'

logs.active: 'Go touch all four. That's the whole job.' Easy money. Ominous money.
logs.completed: Commissioned. Northward, to the graves.

indiscriminate.hint: Take Cerak's commission at the dig camp.

objectives.description: Four monuments no one built, in a graveyard no one visits.

logs.active: Four monuments no one built, in a graveyard no one visits.
logs.completed: The fourth stone wakes something.

indiscriminate.hint: Find and touch all four great gravestones in the Desolate Graves.

objectives.description: Four brief apparitions. Seconds each. No names.

logs.active: Something stirs- brief, wordless, four times over.
logs.completed: No journal entry for this one. Some things don't get written down.

indiscriminate.hint: Witness what the stones remember.

objectives.description: The stones were keys. The shrine is the lock.

logs.active: The stones were keys. The shrine is the lock.
logs.completed: The original sigil site- ancestor of the one Raevula was built around. And a cache within.

indiscriminate.hint: Approach the massive shrine as it wakes.

objectives.description: He witnessed the answer to his life's question. Nobody will ever believe him.

logs.active: He saw it too. He knows nobody will ever believe him.
logs.completed: 'The evidence doesn't care about belief. That's what makes it evidence.'

indiscriminate.hint: Tell Cerak what you saw.

quests.name: Cart Trouble
quests.unknownHint: Gilbert's latest shipment is 'delayed'.
quests.overview: Gilbert's incoming shipment is 'delayed', where 'delayed' means 'inside the Pearlsalt Mines', because his supply route apparently runs THROUGH a monster-infested mine. He insists it's the traditional route. Nobody sane routes goods through those mines. Go fish his crates out anyway.

objectives.description: Where does the stock come from when everything outside the walls wants to eat everyone?

logs.active: 'Thanks to CERTAIN SOMEONES, I've had to update my stock.' What does that even MEAN, old man?
logs.completed: The shipment is 'delayed'. In a mine. Full of monsters. Traditional route, he says.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Gilbert out about the delayed shipment.

objectives.description: Somewhere in the mines, a shipment waits for a braver courier.

logs.active: Who routes a supply line through THIS?
logs.completed: Found them- half-buried and thoroughly guarded.

indiscriminate.hint: Find the stranded crates inside the Pearlsalt Mines.

objectives.description: The local monsters have formed opinions about the crates.

logs.active: The monsters have formed opinions about the crates. Overrule them.
logs.completed: The crates are no longer under new management.

indiscriminate.hint: Clear the hostiles prowling around the shipment.

objectives.description: The goods won't carry themselves home.

logs.active: Grab the goods before something else claims them.
logs.completed: Shipment recovered, mostly intact.

indiscriminate.hint: Recover the shipment from the crate pile.

objectives.description: One stall, always open, awaiting its goods.

logs.active: Haul it all back to the stall that never closes.
logs.completed: Stock updated- thanks to a certain someone. Wait.

indiscriminate.hint: Return the shipment to Gilbert's stall.

quests.name: The Route Less Traveled
quests.unknownHint: Gilbert wants someone to check on a 'supplier contact'.
quests.overview: Gilbert asks you to check on his 'supplier contact' further along the route- through the deep half of the Pearlsalt Mines, out a tunnel that shouldn't be an exit, to a place nobody's seen in years.

objectives.description: The directions are oddly specific for a route nobody sane would use.

logs.active: The directions are oddly specific for a route nobody sane would use.
logs.completed: Directions in hand. Contact presumably at the end of them.

indiscriminate.hint: Get the directions to Gilbert's supplier contact.

objectives.description: The far half of the mines, where the tunnels stop pretending to be safe.

logs.active: The far half of the mines, where the tunnels stop pretending to be safe.
logs.completed: The 'dead end' tunnel isn't one.

indiscriminate.hint: Navigate the deep half of the Pearlsalt Mines.

objectives.description: Daylight, where there should be rock.

logs.active: The tunnel keeps going... and then it's outside.
logs.completed: Not a contact. A camp. Crates, tarps, a fire pit long cold- all marked with a caravan sigil. Nobody has been here in years.

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the tunnel out and find the waystation.

objectives.description: Whatever this place was, its supplies shouldn't rot.

logs.active: Whatever this place was, its supplies shouldn't rot.
logs.completed: The usable goods are packed. The questions are staying.

indiscriminate.hint: Retrieve what's usable from the old camp.

objectives.description: The old man will want to know what you found. Or maybe he won't.

logs.active: He'll want to know what you found. Or maybe he won't.
logs.completed: He overpaid. Noticeably. And explained nothing.

indiscriminate.hint: Bring the salvage back to Gilbert.

quests.name: Where the Road Ends
quests.unknownHint: The old route continues north, toward the Desolate Graves.
quests.overview: The route continues north toward the Desolate Graves- and that is exactly where it ends. Follow the old caravan road to its terminus and learn what the supply line you've been servicing actually is.

objectives.description: The road is old, the markings older, and it ends somewhere nobody goes.

logs.active: The road is old, the markings older. It ends somewhere nobody goes.
logs.completed: The road ends in the Desolate Graves.

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the old caravan road north.

objectives.description: What is left of the caravan is exactly what a graveyard holds.

logs.active: The caravan sigil appears one last time, carved in stone.
logs.completed: Graves. His people. The supply line has ended here for years.

indiscriminate.hint: Find what remains of the caravan.

objectives.description: The first time in the entire game that the stall stands empty.

logs.active: The first time in living memory that the stall stands empty.
logs.completed: A solemn nod, one line of respect, and back to business. The stall doesn't run itself.

indiscriminate.hint: Stand with Gilbert at the graves.

objectives.description: The road back is quiet.

logs.active: The road back is quiet.
logs.completed: 'Thanks to CERTAIN SOMEONES, I've had to update my stock.' Same words. New meaning.

indiscriminate.hint: Return to Raevula.

quests.name: Nare Or Not
quests.unknownHint: The Believer and the Skeptic have pooled their savings for something.
quests.overview: The two men who have argued about Gilbert for approximately forever have pooled their savings to settle it once and for all: follow his next 'Nare shipment' order to its source. The trail is real, well-marked, professionally maintained. Follow it to the end.

objectives.description: Two men, one bet, zero chance either accepts the outcome.

logs.active: Two men, one bet, zero chance either accepts the outcome.
logs.completed: The savings of two lifetimes, wagered on one merchant's supply chain.

indiscriminate.hint: Take the commission from the Believer and the Skeptic.

objectives.description: The trail is immaculate. Suspiciously immaculate.

logs.active: The trail is immaculate. Suspiciously immaculate.
logs.completed: The trail loops. In a great circle. Right back to the rear of Gilbert's stall.

indiscriminate.hint: Follow the 'Nare shipment' trail to its source.

objectives.description: The truth has been found. It changes absolutely nothing.

logs.active: Deliver the truth and watch it change absolutely nothing.
logs.completed: Both men declare total vindication. The debate continues. Nothing is answered. Nothing will ever be answered.

indiscriminate.hint: Report back to the Believer and the Skeptic.

quests.name: Tell Me Everything
quests.unknownHint: The lady by the vacant lot somehow knows everything about everyone.
quests.overview: Amy trades in rumors, and you two are walking rumor-generators. She wants an exclusive: something she doesn't already know, verified firsthand, from beyond the walls. In exchange, she'll mark a couple of points of interest that only the town switchboard knows about.

objectives.description: The town switchboard wants an exclusive, and you're the source.

logs.active: The town switchboard wants an exclusive, and you're the source.
logs.completed: Deal: one exclusive, payable in firsthand proof.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Amy's proposition.

objectives.description: Something she doesn't already know- which is a shockingly short list.

logs.active: Something she doesn't already know- which is a shockingly short list.
logs.completed: Verified. Firsthand. Exclusive. She's beaming.

indiscriminate.hint: Bring Amy firsthand proof of something from beyond the walls.

objectives.description: Knowledge for knowledge- the switchboard pays its debts.

logs.active: Knowledge for knowledge- the switchboard pays its debts.
logs.completed: A couple of points of interest, marked. Worth every rumor.

indiscriminate.hint: Collect your payment in local knowledge.

quests.name: The Vacant Lot
quests.overview: The plot Amy stands beside is her white whale: WHY did the nature-lover abandon a perfectly good house? She wants the story from the source- and the source fled to the Forest of Dreams.

objectives.description: Of all the mysteries in town, this is the one that keeps her up at night.

logs.active: Of all the mysteries in town, this is the one that keeps her up at night.
logs.completed: The assignment: find the hippie, get the story.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear about Amy's white whale.

objectives.description: Only the source knows why she abandoned a perfectly good house.

logs.active: The forest hippie knows why she abandoned a perfectly good house.
logs.completed: 'The mayor radiated evil vibes.' Which, post-Wyatt, is retroactively excellent judgment.

indiscriminate.hint: Ask the Nature-Lover in the Forest of Dreams why she left.

objectives.description: The truth is stranger and more validating than any rumor.

logs.active: The truth is stranger and more validating than any rumor.
logs.completed: Amy has EXTENSIVE feelings about this. You are now a peer, not a source.

indiscriminate.hint: Bring the truth back to Amy.

quests.name: Whispers From Below
quests.unknownHint: Amy has a category of story she never retells.
quests.overview: Amy has been collecting a category of story she doesn't retell: miner stories. The deep shaft. The ones who went too far down and didn't come back. She doesn't gossip about these- and that's the tell that they're true.

objectives.description: The switchboard has a drawer it keeps locked. Today it opens.

logs.active: The switchboard has a drawer it keeps locked. Today it opens.
logs.completed: Miner stories. The deep shaft. The ones who didn't come back.

indiscriminate.hint: Ask Amy about the stories she never retells.

objectives.description: Where the old-timers say the deep entrance is, and why nobody strings lights down there anymore.

logs.active: Where the deep entrance is, and why nobody strings lights down there anymore.
logs.completed: The door is marked. What's behind it, she won't say. Nobody will.

indiscriminate.hint: Learn what Amy has gathered about the deep shaft.

quests.name: The Fort
quests.unknownHint: The snotty kid finally let someone through her front door.
quests.overview: Four chapters of holding the door, and Silia finally lets you in- not because she trusts you, but because you're the only people in town who go where she can't. Inside, the house is... kept. Tidy. A place at the table, set. She wants help gathering supplies dad likes.

objectives.description: Four chapters of 'you may not enter my abode', and now: entry.

logs.active: Four chapters of 'you may not enter my abode', and now: entry.
logs.completed: The house is kept. Tidy. A place at the table, set.

indiscriminate.hint: Enter Silia's house, at long last.

objectives.description: The list is precise. The list is practiced.

logs.active: Miner's rations, lamp oil, pearl salt. The list is precise. The list is practiced.
logs.completed: Everything on the list, exactly as specified.

indiscriminate.hint: Gather the supplies dad likes- miner's rations, lamp oil, pearl salt.

objectives.description: Everything has a place, and every place is 'for when dad's back'.

logs.active: Everything has a place, and every place is 'for when dad's back'.
logs.completed: The duo thinks it's a game. It isn't a game.

indiscriminate.hint: Help Silia put the supplies away, exactly right.

quests.name: Deep Delivery
quests.overview: Silia asks you to deliver her father's lamp to 'where he's working- the deep part'. Adventurers can go where kids can't.

objectives.description: The lamp is small, well-kept, and heavier than it should be.

logs.active: 'Deliver it to where he's working. The deep part.' Adventurers can go where kids can't.
logs.completed: The lamp is small, well-kept, and heavier than it should be.

indiscriminate.hint: Accept the lamp from Silia.

objectives.description: The deep entrance waits, and the lamp must reach it.

logs.active: The deep entrance waits, and the lamp must reach it.
logs.completed: The lamp is where he'd find it.

indiscriminate.hint: Carry the lamp to the deep entrance.

objectives.description: What do you even say on the way back?

logs.active: What do you even say on the way back?
logs.completed: His lamp, shared: the Miner's Charm. Her exterior softens by one degree. One.

indiscriminate.hint: Return to Silia.

quests.name: Audition One
quests.unknownHint: The cat-woman is convinced she should be in your party.
quests.overview: Nyancy demands a formal party audition. Her demonstrated skills include knocking valuable items off high surfaces, ignoring direct instructions, and landing on her feet from a height of one (1) fence.

objectives.description: The audition has a program. The program is laminated.

logs.active: The audition has a program. The program is laminated.
logs.completed: Skills demonstrated: gravity-assisted item redistribution, selective hearing, one (1) fence.

indiscriminate.hint: Attend Nyancy's formal party audition.

objectives.description: Someone has to tell her. Rupert won't let Jerald do it.

logs.active: Someone has to tell her. Rupert won't let Jerald do it.
logs.completed: Verdict: no. Her takeaway: 'So there's an opening.'

indiscriminate.hint: Deliver the verdict.

quests.name: Audition Two
quests.overview: She has trained. New skills: sitting in boxes regardless of box size, staring at a wall with enormous purpose, and a sixty-percent-accurate pounce.

objectives.description: She has TRAINED. The program is longer now.

logs.active: She has TRAINED. The program is longer now.
logs.completed: The box does not fit. She sits regardless. The wall is stared at with enormous purpose.

indiscriminate.hint: Attend the second audition.

objectives.description: The pounce is sixty percent accurate. The confidence is one hundred.

logs.active: The pounce is sixty percent accurate. The confidence is one hundred.
logs.completed: Verdict: no. Her takeaway: 'I could feel you hesitate.'

indiscriminate.hint: Deliver the verdict. Again.

quests.name: The Final Audition
quests.overview: The third and final audition. What happens in it is, in retrospect, the most feline possible outcome.

objectives.description: Third time's the charm. For someone. Possibly.

logs.active: Third time's the charm. For someone. Possibly.
logs.completed: Three unbroken minutes of actual, genuine grace.

indiscriminate.hint: Attend the final audition.

objectives.description: She's walking away. Mid-verdict. She lost interest.

logs.active: She's walking away. Mid-verdict. She lost interest.
logs.completed: The most feline possible outcome.

indiscriminate.hint: Deliver the ver- wait, where is she going?

objectives.description: She has decided to teach YOU something, 'since you clearly need it more'.

logs.active: She has decided to teach YOU something, 'since you clearly need it more'.
logs.completed: Cat's Grace, learned. You are now her understudies. Forever.

indiscriminate.hint: Receive her magnanimous parting gift.

quests.name: The Estate
quests.unknownHint: The mayor's mansion has reopened, and its keeper needs help.
quests.overview: Frederick asks for help inventorying the mansion- the town wants answers about its mayor, and nobody else will set foot in the place. Sweep the wings, catalog what's found. Among it: Wyatt's records.

objectives.description: The page kept a dead monster's estate for three chapters. Now he needs witnesses.

logs.active: The page kept a dead monster's estate for three chapters. Now he needs witnesses.
logs.completed: The job: sweep the wings, catalog everything, flinch at nothing.

indiscriminate.hint: Speak with Frederick at the mansion.

objectives.description: Nobody else will set foot in here. Understandably.

logs.active: Nobody else will set foot in here. Understandably.
logs.completed: Cataloged: the ordinary, the expensive, and the deeply unsettling.

indiscriminate.hint: Sweep the mansion's wings and catalog what's found.

objectives.description: How long was he the Sin of Gluttony? What was he before?

logs.active: How long was he the Sin of Gluttony? What was he before?
logs.completed: The records raise more questions than they bury.

indiscriminate.hint: Examine Wyatt's records.

objectives.description: The town wanted answers. These are the ones there are.

logs.active: The town wanted answers. These are the ones there are.
logs.completed: The estate is accounted for. The town can begin to process.

indiscriminate.hint: Report the inventory to Frederick.

quests.name: The Question of Governance
quests.overview: The inventory forces the issue nobody has said out loud since chapter one: Raevula has no mayor. You killed him. The town needs governance, Vanderslop is pressing his lineage claim, and Frederick- who served one monster- refuses to install another by default.

objectives.description: The town finally addresses the thing nobody has said since chapter one.

logs.active: The town finally addresses the thing nobody has said since chapter one.
logs.completed: The question is on the table: who governs Raevula?

indiscriminate.hint: Attend the town's reckoning at the mansion.

objectives.description: A lineage claim from a man whose lineage was a monster.

logs.active: A lineage claim from a man whose lineage was a monster.
logs.completed: The claims are made. The town remembers everything.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear out the claims- including Vanderslop's.

objectives.description: Whatever the town decides, it decides with its eyes open this time.

logs.active: Whatever the town decides, it decides with its eyes open this time.
logs.completed: Raevula has governance again. The gossip network updates town-wide.

indiscriminate.hint: See the question of governance settled.

quests.name: The West Wing
quests.overview: Nobody in town will live in the mansion- the mayor ate people there. Frederick, with whatever authority the town has left, grants the duo the West Wing: the room they were locked in becomes theirs. The prison becomes the home.

objectives.description: The room you were locked in, offered as a gift.

logs.active: Nobody will live in the mansion. Nobody normal, anyway.
logs.completed: The room you were locked in, offered as a gift. The symmetry is not lost on anyone.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Frederick's proposal for the West Wing.

objectives.description: The prison becomes the home.

logs.active: The prison becomes the home.
logs.completed: The West Wing is yours. Frederick finally serves something worth serving. His words.

indiscriminate.hint: Take possession of the West Wing.

quests.name: Master's Standard
quests.unknownHint: Viktor has opinions about your forging. Loud ones.
quests.overview: Supervised commissions: forge the set he assigns and deliver it to his bench for critique. The critiques are loud, unsparing, and- you may notice- never actually explain HOW to be better. Grading is not teaching.

objectives.description: Three pieces, his choosing, his standards.

logs.active: Three pieces, his choosing, his standards. No pressure.
logs.completed: The assignment is issued. The standards are implied. Loudly.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

indiscriminate.hint: Take Viktor's commission at the Metal Petal forge.

objectives.description: The assigned set, forged and delivered to the master's bench.

logs.active: Forge the set, deliver to the bench, brace for critique.
logs.completed: Delivered. He's inspecting. The silence is worse than the shouting.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

indiscriminate.hint: Forge the assigned set and deliver it to Viktor's bench.

objectives.description: Loud. Unsparing. Weirdly devoid of actual instruction.

logs.active: Loud. Unsparing. Weirdly devoid of actual instruction.
logs.completed: Graded, not taught. That gap is going to matter.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

indiscriminate.hint: Endure the critique.

quests.name: Say It Plain
quests.overview: Viskra's latest piece sits on Viktor's bench awaiting review. He grunts '8/10, handle's wrong' and goes back to work- then drafts actual feedback, and crumples it. Six times. Somebody has to carry this man twenty feet.

objectives.description: Draft. Crumple. Draft. Crumple.

logs.active: Draft. Crumple. Draft. Crumple. Six times now.
logs.completed: The wastebasket is full of almost-communication.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

quests.name: The Old Way
quests.unknownHint: Viktor hesitates whenever named weapons come up.
quests.overview: You've heard the named-weapon lore- the soul, the price, most of them long since lost. This quest makes him say it TO VISKRA: full history, true cost. logs.active: Synthesize the essence without the sacrifice. Reform, at a forge.
logs.completed: The plan is set; the list of components is exotic.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Viktor's plan for the new way.

objectives.description: The components come from the far corners of the continent.

logs.active: The components come from the far corners of the continent.
logs.completed: Everything on the list, hauled home.
logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

indiscriminate.hint: Fetch the late-zone exotics on Viktor's list.

objectives.description: The first Smith's Soulcrystal ever made without a death.

objectives.description: Still profane. But a teacher.

logs.missed: The Metal Petal closed before this could ever happen.

quests.name: Her Own Mark
quests.unknownHint: Viskra wants to forge something with HER name on it.

objectives.description: Her own mark, on her own steel.

objectives.description: It's good. It's genuinely good.

quests.name: Validation

objectives.description: 8/10 from the master is 8/10.

quests.name: Something Missing

indiscriminate.hint: Hear Viktor's review.

quests.name: The Soul of the Craft
quests.unknownHint: Viskra has one more materials run- the strangest list yet.
quests.overview: One more materials run: late-zone exotics, and a stone tablet. You'll read this as quest N+1 of a beloved chain. It is not.

objectives.description: Back to the Metal Petal, haul in hand.

quests.name: Drills
quests.unknownHint: The city guard keeps watching your fights and taking notes.
quests.overview: Cecil, having watched two demigods stroll through town, swallows his pride and asks them to train him. It goes badly, then less badly, then- once- genuinely well.

objectives.description: The town's only guard wants lessons from the town's biggest menaces.

logs.active: The town's only guard wants lessons from the town's biggest menaces.
logs.completed: Pride: swallowed. Training: scheduled.

indiscriminate.hint: Accept Cecil's training request.

objectives.description: It goes badly. Then less badly.

logs.completed: Once- just once- he holds a parry against Jerald. His face is the whole reward.

objectives.description: Teaching teaches the teacher.

indiscriminate.hint: Wrap up the training session.

quests.name: The Patrol Route
quests.overview: He invites you on his actual patrol: the full circuit of Raevula, at night. Nothing attacks. That's not the point. The point is what the town looks like at night, and one man walking the whole of it, every night, unpaid and unasked, because somebody should.

objectives.description: The full circuit of Raevula, after dark.

indiscriminate.hint: Walk the full circuit with Cecil.

objectives.description: One man, every night, unpaid and unasked. Because somebody should.

indiscriminate.hint: Finish the route and hear him out.

quests.name: Tribute (I)

quests.name: Letters Home
quests.unknownHint: The foreign gentleman speaks of the Kingdom like he was just there.
